heroWelcome.title: Welcome to the Connecting Climate Minds Hub, where the worlds of mental health and climate change research unite.

children.text: We are dedicated to fostering a connected global research community, all driven by a common goal:understanding and addressing the intricate relationship between our planet's changing climate and our mental health.

howToUse.title: Your collaborative space for ideas, dialogue, and connection

collaboration.title: Your collaborative space for ideas, dialogue, and connection

children.text: Whether you want to delve into priority areas for research and action, seek inspiration and understanding from case studies, personal experiences and insights, learn from "how to" toolkits, or are looking to join our growing global community and form new connections, this hub is for you.
